text.p: Communications Systems Inc said Monday its pending divesture of its contract manufacturing unit Zercom has already had an impact on the company's results, including an improvement in margins.

Communications Systems said its gross margin rose to 32 percent in the third quarter of 1996 from 22 percent in the second when Zercom was still included in the consolidated operating results. It said its operating margin on continuing operations rose to 16 percent in the third quarter from seven percent in the second.
"(T)he pending divesture of Zercom is already having its intended impact by improving the company's overall profitability," the company said in a statement.
Earlier, Communications Systems, a telecommunications company, reported third quarter earnings from continuing operations of $0.26 a share versus $0.24 last year.
